text:
maya: Heads-up: Sherwood Health private/VPC deploy window booked for Thu Apr 22 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need owners for deployment, smoke, rollback readiness. TLDR: no schema migrations; small model bump + runtime config changes. @samir can you own infra steps?

samir: I'll take infra. Plan: 02:30 UTC prep, 03:00 start rollout. Doing infra patch and KV cache warmup. Will post smoke commands.

kevin: I'll own app rollout and canary. Plan: 03:00 -> 10% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% if clean. I can be oncall for rollback.

emily: I can run perf smoke + latency dashboard during canary. Need a prometheus dashboard link? ping me 02:45.

tony: I'll run post-deploy smoke (integration tests + e2e signin). ETA to start at 03:20.

zach: Heads-up: DB replicas will be throttled for a bit due to cache population. No write migrations. I'm on standby.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: Sherwood key:deploy-789 start at 03:00 UTC. Noted canary policy kevin-10-50. Notify @eng-oncall on failures.

ops-bot: Change window lock acquired by maya. Rollback window until 05:00 UTC.

maya: Smoke checklist (short): 1) health endpoints 2) embedding accuracy spot-check 3) token stats for inf latency 4) error budget check. Tony + Emily to run.

samir: Smoke commands: `kubectl -n sherwood-rollout get pods` then `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://sherwood-api.prod/health'`. Also `redis-cli --latency` on cache nodes.

kevin: `/deploy start deploy-789 --canary 10 --canary-duration 10m` (this is the CLI we'll use). If errors > 1% abort.

emily: I'll open a short Grafana panel: https://grafana.company/s/sherwood (will post timeboxed link at 02:50).

tony: :thumbsup: will run e2e suite `tests/acceptance/sherwood` after 50% step.

maya: Rollback plan: instant rollback via `/deploy rollback deploy-789` to previous image (tag: release-2026-04-12). Kept DB schema unchanged so rollback should be safe. @zach + @kevin confirm.

zach: Confirmed rollback safe from DB side. Watch for cache stale keys, may need `cache:invalidate --prefix=sherwood/v2`.

kevin: Confirmed. If we hit >0.5 rps error spike or latency p50 > 300ms for 5m, I will rollback.

samir: I'll pre-warm KV cache starting 02:40 and keep a manifest of warmed keys. I'll also snapshot config and node counts.

maya: Coord notes: please update this thread when you are 'ready' and when you 'started' + 'completed' each major step. Emily/Tony please post smoke pass/fail docs.

emily: ready — dashboards up, alert windows set. Will post at 03:10 first pass.

tony: ready — test infra green locally.

kevin: ready — Canary policy loaded in deploy system.

zach: ready — DB replicas VERIFIED, throttles set.

samir: started prep @02:30 UTC — patching runtime images on staging nodes.

deploy-bot: deploy-789: stage -> canary started at 03:00 UTC (canary 10%).

kevin: started canary 10% at 03:00.

emily: 03:05 smoke: health ✅, p50=110ms, errors=0.1% — will recheck at 03:12.

tony: 03:15 e2e after 50% step — signin + generate both OK. No regressions.

kevin: bumping to 50% at 03:20.

emily: 03:25 second smoke: p50=130ms, errors=0.2% — passing.

maya: If all good -> full rollout at 03:35, otherwise hold and triage.

kevin: 03:35 full rollout started.

deploy-bot: deploy-789: rollout to 100% started at 03:35 UTC. No active alerts.

emily: 03:45 post-deploy perf: p50=140ms, p95=320ms, errors=0.15% — within SLOs.

tony: 03:50 all acceptance tests ✅. Marking completed.

maya: Completed — closing change window. Notes: minor config tuning required next week (samir). Thanks everyone :tada:

zach: closing note: I cleared the cache invalidate step not required.
